scope: single face correction review; no animation or runtime replacement yet
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE corrected full-body transparent Buddy note-taking image.
INPUT1 buddy_master.png is the PRIMARY EDIT BASE and exact face/character authority. INPUT2 is ONLY a reference for the pen/card/paw action, NOT its face. Its flattened eyes/tilted face are rejected.

Start from INPUT1: retain the SAME wide rounded head, large ROUND glossy black eyes, original eye size/spacing and round catchlights, original cheeks/blush, original cute warm D-shaped open smile with dark-purple inside and pink tongue, round plush ears/pink cups, fine lavender plush, small chubby seated torso/short limbs, foot heart pads plus3toe beans, and soft studio lighting. Make Buddy look like the same lovable toy as the original, not a generic bear. No eyebrows/nose/teeth/white sclera/human fingers/star.
Do NOT squash, slant or flatten the eyes. No narrow oval eyes, twisted face, steep sideways head tilt, long forehead, exaggerated crown, stretched mouth, giant grin or worried/sleepy expression.

Change the master's arm pose: one rounded furry paw supports a small BLANK warm-cream rounded card resting naturally across the lap, slightly angled toward Buddy; the other paw holds ONE slim forest-green pen whose nib touches the card. One paw supports card, one holds pen. No extra fingers/limbs or floating/fused pen. Card about55% of head width, do not cover face/feet. Pen about35% of head width.
Buddy looks pleasantly attentive toward the card with just a SMALL natural downward head dip, about5–8 degrees, keeping the master face round and adorable. Keep both glossy eyes round and wide open; prioritize the faithful master face over exaggerated downward perspective. The nib/card contact must be visible. Calm affectionate note-taking, not an odd theatrical face.
Card MUST be entirely blank: NO printed content, writing, scribbles, numbers or lines. The app will later draw black strokes exactly under a moving pen tip; those must not be baked in.
Composition: full seated body, near-front master camera angle, same head/body proportions, feet on common baseline, comfortable8% empty padding, whole ears/paws visible. Genuine transparent alpha background with soft clean fur edges, no floor/shadow/white rectangle/halo/text/watermark. One image only.
